zh: 艾希特大学为英国顶级大学之一. 大学前身为1900年成立的「皇家亚伯特纪念学院」（Royal Albert Memorial College）和1922年创校的「西南英格兰大学学院」（University College of the South West of England）. 于1955年获得皇家特许，正式升格为大学. 大学位于英国西南部德文郡艾希特. 艾希特大学曾是英国大学「1994年集团」成员之一. 2012年3月12日，艾希特大学退出1994年集团，加入有英国常春藤联盟之称的罗素集团. 艾希特大学，跟英格兰西南部巴斯大学、布里斯托大学，以及威尔斯的卡地夫大学组成 GW4 联盟. 这个由四所研究型大学组成的联盟于2013 年1月成立，旨在加强研究合作和创新. 2023年，GW4 联盟，联同惠普、NVIDIA 和 Arm，获得英国研究与创新组织拨款1,000 万英镑，用于开发 Isambard 3 超级电脑，用作人工智慧和高效能运算. 该电脑已于2024年12月正式运作.

艾希特大学位于英国西部城市艾希特 (Exeter)，距离伦敦约2.5小时火车车程. 艾希特是一个治安良好、消费价格合理和绿化的城市. 艾希特大学Streatham主校园拥有超过250英亩的公园. 校园主校园距Exeter市中心只需10分钟步行. * 1) -{zh-hans:斯特里萨姆;zh-hk:史卓咸;zh-tw:斯特里萨;}-校区 (Streatham campus)：校本部，邻近艾希特市中心，包括商学院、法学院等科系，均在此校区上课. * 2) 圣路克校区(St Luke's campus)：邻近艾希特市中心，教育学院及体育学院在此校区上课. * 3) -{zh-hans:康沃尔;zh-hk:歌和老;zh-tw:康瓦尔;}-校区(Cornwall Campus)：位于康沃尔郡.

艾希特大学的成立是经过几所学府合并而成. 早于1851年，当时在艾希特市举行了一场展览会，引起了公众对艺术和科学的兴趣，随后在1855年创立了"艾希特艺术学校"(Exeter School of Art). 及后1863年成立了"艾希特科学学校"(Exeter School of Science). 上述两所学府于1900年合并成"皇家亚伯特纪念学院"(Royal Albert Memorial College)，并于到1922年它成为了"西南英格兰大学学院"，现址这就是今天艾希特大学的Streatham校区. 学院于1955年获得皇家特许，升格成为艾希特大学. 艾希特大学现有全日制学生25,000多名(2019/2020)，其中有来自130个国家和5400多名来自非英国/欧盟的留学生.
艾希特大学一共有17所学院，专长学科包括商科、艺术、牙医、教育、工程、法律、医学、科学、人文学科、社会科学及运动科学，各学院均提供各种学士及硕士或课程. 教育学院为全国第二大，而科学及工程学院则受益于欧洲研究及发展辅助机构（European Research and Development Assistant Institute）.

en: The University of Exeter is a research university in the West Country of England, with its main campus in Exeter, Devon. Its predecessor institutions, St Luke's College, Exeter School of Science, Exeter School of Art, and the Camborne School of Mines were established in 1838, 1855, 1863, and 1888 respectively. These institutions later formed the University of Exeter after receiving its royal charter in 1955. In post-nominals, the University of Exeter is abbreviated as Exon. (from the Latin Exoniensis), and is the suffix given to honorary and academic degrees from the university.

The university has four campuses: Streatham and St Luke's (both of which are in Exeter); and Truro and Penryn (both of which are in Cornwall). The university is primarily located in the city of Exeter, where it is the principal higher education institution. Streatham is the largest campus containing many of the university's administrative buildings. The Penryn campus is maintained in conjunction with Falmouth University under the Combined Universities in Cornwall (CUC) initiative. The Exeter Streatham Campus Library holds more than 1.2 million physical library resources, including historical journals and special collections. The annual income of the institution for 2023–24 was £666.6 million of which £129.2 million was from research grants and contracts, with an expenditure of £480.5 million.

It was one of the pre-World War II local university colleges granted university status in the 1950s, as part of the second wave of civic universities. In 2012, Exeter joined the Russell Group of research-intensive UK universities. It is also a member of Universities UK, the European University Association, and the Association of Commonwealth Universities and an accredited institution of the Association of MBAs (AMBA).
The university's origins can be traced back to three separate educational institutions that existed in the city of Exeter and in Cornwall in the middle of the 19th century.

To celebrate the educational and scientific work of Prince Albert, and inspired by the Great Exhibition of 1851, Exeter School of Art in 1855 and the Exeter School of Science in 1863 were founded. In 1868, the Schools of Art and Science relocated to Royal Albert Memorial Museum in Queen Street, Exeter, and, with support from the University of Cambridge, became the Exeter Technical and University Extension College in 1893.
